text: Genetic engineers Clive Nicoli and Elsa Kast, a couple hoping for fame, splice animal genes for a drug company and [secretly add human DNA|trigger|playing god] against their employers' orders. The result is Dren, [a fast-growing female hybrid|images|monsters and hybrid creatures] with gills, wings and a stinging tail, whom Elsa raises like a daughter. Hidden on the isolated farm where Elsa grew up, Dren grows restless and strange, and Clive learns [the human DNA is Elsa's own|wrong|meddling with life itself].
